basic_details.job_title: CMFRI Young Professional I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Central Marine Fisheries Research Institute (ICAR-CMFRI), Department of Agricultural Research and Education, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers’ Welfare, Govt. of India, has released a recruitment notification for the post of Young Professional–I under the project entitled “National Innovations in Climate Resilient Agriculture (NICRA)” at the ICAR-CMFRI Field Laboratory, Kavaratti. Eligible candidates must submit their bio-data and scanned original supporting documents through the designated Google Form on or before 17 November 2026.

age_limit.details: The minimum age is 21 years and the maximum age is 45 years (with relaxation as per rules) as on the date of the interview.

qualification.details: B.F.Sc / B.Sc Aquaculture / Marine Biology or other equivalent branch of biological science.

how_to_apply: Fill out the bio-data and prepare scanned copies of original supporting documents, including certificates from matriculation onwards, Annexure-I, and Annexure-II duly signed.
Access the online application portal via the official Google Form link: https://forms.gle/PtQz3VbKgMkC522Y7.
Submit the bio-data, scanned certificates, and completed annexures through the Google form on or before 17 November 2026.
Ensure all certificates from matriculation are uploaded; applicants without these certificates will not be allowed to appear for the interview.
Wait for intimation by e-mail if shortlisted, and appear for the interview (offline/online) at ICAR-CMFRI Field Laboratory, Kavaratti, on the specified date and time along with one valid ID proof.
important_instructions: Candidates must send all original certificates from matriculation in scanned form through the Google form on or before 17.11.2026; without these, applicants will not be allowed to appear for the interview. Candidates should produce one valid ID proof at the time of the interview. Concealing of facts or canvassing in any form shall lead to disqualification or termination. The competent authority reserves the right to terminate the appointment without assigning any reason at any time. If any near or distant relatives are employees of ICAR-CMFRI, the candidate must declare their name, designation, nature of duties, and relationship in writing, and furnish the declaration detailed in Annexure-II. Candidates must furnish the declarations in ANNEXURE-I and ANNEXURE-II duly signed and submit them through the Google form on or before 17.11.2026. Candidates should produce a No Objection Certificate from their present employer, if applicable. Candidates having marks issued in the form of CGPA/OGPA must produce an approved conversion table or formula at the time of reporting for the interview.

content_sections.heading: About CMFRI Young Professional-I
content_sections.text: The recruitment is conducted by the ICAR-CMFRI Field Laboratory, located at the KVK-Lakshadweep Campus, Second Floor, AD Unit, Kavaratti-682555, UT of Lakshadweep. The selected candidate will work for the National Innovations in Climate Resilient Agriculture (NICRA) project on a contractual, non-regular, time-bound basis. The appointment is co-terminus with the project for a maximum period of five years.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification provides for a single post under the project.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the essential educational qualifications and age limits prescribed in the official notification to be eligible for consideration. B.F.Sc / B.Sc Aquaculture / Marine Biology or other equivalent branch of biological science. M.F.Sc or M.Sc. with experiences in seagrass restoration / seaweed farming will be preferred. Skilled in swimming will be given preference. The minimum age is 21 years and the maximum age is 45 years (with relaxation as per rules) as on the date of the interview.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a fixed monthly emolument of Rs. 30,000/-. The position is purely contractual, non-regular, time-bound, and co-terminus with the project for five years or till the completion of the project, whichever is earlier. Selected candidates cannot claim any regular appointments at the institute.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CMFRI Young Professional-I
content_sections.text: Fill out the bio-data and prepare scanned copies of original supporting documents, including certificates from matriculation onwards, Annexure-I, and Annexure-II duly signed. Access the online application portal via the official Google Form link: https://forms.gle/PtQz3VbKgMkC522Y7. Submit the bio-data, scanned certificates, and completed annexures through the Google form on or before 17 November 2026. Ensure all certificates from matriculation are uploaded; applicants without these certificates will not be allowed to appear for the interview. Wait for intimation by e-mail if shortlisted, and appear for the interview (offline/online) at ICAR-CMFRI Field Laboratory, Kavaratti, on the specified date and time along with one valid ID proof.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: An interview (offline or online) is scheduled to be held at the ICAR-CMFRI Field Laboratory, Kavaratti. Shortlisted candidates will be intimated by e-mail, and only those who receive communication may appear for the interview on the specified date and time. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing for the interview.
